domain(person,[sylvia]).
% If Sylvia studies electromagnetic waves and conducts innovative experiments, then she will make groundbreaking discoveries.
axiom(s1, rule([and(studies_electromagnetic_waves(sylvia), conducts_innovative_experiments(sylvia))], make_groundbreaking_discoveries(sylvia))).
% Sylvia understands wave theory.
axiom(s2, understands_wave_theory(sylvia)).
% If Sylvia explores new ideas, then she either collaborates with others or advances her field.
axiom(s3, rule([explores_new_ideas(sylvia)], or(collaborates_with_others(sylvia), advances_her_field(sylvia)))).
% If someone collects data and understands wave theory, then they can analyze signal patterns.
axiom(s4, rule([and(collects_data(X), understands_wave_theory(X))], analyzes_signal_patterns(X))).
% Sylvia does not advance her field.
axiom(s5, not(advances_her_field(sylvia))).
% Sylvia explores new ideas or conducts innovative experiments.
axiom(s6, or(explores_new_ideas(sylvia), conducts_innovative_experiments(sylvia))).
% Sylvia builds on existing research.
axiom(s7, builds_on_existing_research(sylvia)).
% If Sylvia has a PhD, then she either analyzes signal patterns or specializes in acoustics, but not both.
axiom(s8, rule([has_phd(sylvia)], xor(analyzes_signal_patterns(sylvia), specializes_in_acoustics(sylvia)))).
% Sylvia collects data.
axiom(s9, collects_data(sylvia)).
% If someone has curiosity, then they explore new ideas and solve complex problems.
axiom(s10, rule([has_curiosity(X)], and(explores_new_ideas(X), solves_complex_problems(X)))).
% If Sylvia either analyzes signal patterns or studies electromagnetic waves (but not both), then she pioneers new technologies.
axiom(s11, rule([xor(analyzes_signal_patterns(sylvia), studies_electromagnetic_waves(sylvia))], pioneers_new_technologies(sylvia))).
% For Sylvia, pioneering new technologies and building on existing research are mutually exclusive.
axiom(s12, xor(pioneers_new_technologies(sylvia), builds_on_existing_research(sylvia))).
% Sylvia does not collaborate with others.
axiom(s13, not(collaborates_with_others(sylvia))).
